sources.limits: Ranked, Emerald+. Public MCP has no region or patch input; patch is from returned trend, region unverified. Provider core may include components/transformed items and is not a complete six-slot inventory. Rune and item sample selections are separate; no causal superiority claim.

Emerald+, GLOBAL, Ranked Solo/Duo. Selected Highest Win Build, not Most Common. Core includes boots/quest items where shown. Core sample differs from champion-role cohort. Displayed rune statistics describe the primary keystone, not the entire rune page; rune and core samples are separate. High observed win rate is affected by sample size, matchup and item completion; it does not prove build superiority.
